commits.name: Commit-0
commits.content:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: relay
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: relay
      POSTGRES_DB: relay
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - relay_postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data

  api:
    build: .
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+psycopg://relay:relay@db:5432/relay
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}
      OPENAI_MODEL: ${OPENAI_MODEL:-gpt-4o-mini}
      JWT_SECRET: ${JWT_SECRET:-replace-me-before-production}
      ADMIN_EMAIL: ${ADMIN_EMAIL:-admin@acme.co}
      ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${ADMIN_PASSWORD:-relay-demo-2026}
      ADMIN_NAME: ${ADMIN_NAME:-Acme Administrator}
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    depends_on:
      - db

volumes:
  relay_postgres_data:
